name: How long does a typical dog bite injury claim take to resolve?
description: The resolution time for a dog bite claim varies; simple cases may take months, while complex ones with severe injuries can take a year or more.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical dog bite injury claim take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a dog bite injury claim can vary significantly. Simple cases with clear liability and minor injuries might resolve in a few months, while more complex cases involving severe injuries, extensive medical treatment, or disputes over liability could take a year or more. Factors like insurance company cooperation, the extent of injuries, and court schedules all influence the timeline. Your lawyer can provide a more specific estimate after reviewing your case.
